title: TAT-3490 Perps cancel-order reliability
description: Proves the Perps cancel flow on HyperLiquid testnet: a live open order is cancelled from the market-detail modal, and an order that the provider no longer holds open ends the flow cleanly with the 'no longer open' toast instead of an unactionable error.

setup-select-account.intent: Select the funded Perps trading account

setup-start-state.intent: Start from a clean ETH testnet Perps state

ac1-ensure-order-open.intent: AC1: create the resting ETH order that the UI will cancel

ac1-navigate-market.intent: AC1: open the ETH market detail page that lists open orders

ac1-wait-order-card.intent: AC1: confirm the resting order is listed

ac1-open-cancel-modal.intent: AC1: open the cancel-order modal for the resting order

ac1-wait-modal.intent: AC1: the cancel-order dialog is on screen with its cancel action

ac1-wait-modal-closed.intent: AC1: the dialog is gone once the order is cancelled

ac1-assert-orders-absent.intent: AC1: confirm the order is gone from the provider

ac2-ensure-order-open.intent: AC2: create the resting ETH order used for the stale-cancel race

ac2-wait-order-card.intent: AC2: confirm the resting order is listed again

ac2-open-cancel-modal.intent: AC2: open the cancel-order modal for the resting order

ac2-wait-modal.intent: AC2: the cancel-order dialog is on screen with its cancel action

ac2-cancel-out-of-band.intent: AC2: cancel the order outside the modal so the modal now holds a stale order

ac2-press-cancel.intent: AC2: submit a cancel for an order the provider no longer holds open

ac2-wait-toast.intent: AC2: confirm the neutral 'no longer open' toast is shown instead of a failure

ac2-screenshot.label: AC2: cancel modal dismissed with the 'This order is no longer open' toast
ac2-screenshot.intent: Show the trader back on the market page with a neutral "no longer open" notice and no error banner

ac2-wait-modal-closed.intent: AC2: the dialog is gone instead of holding the trader on an error they cannot act on

ac2-assert-orders-absent.intent: AC2: confirm no ETH order is left open

teardown-state.intent: Restore a clean Perps state after the proof

setup-wait-app-ready.intent: The wallet home screen is ready for the trader to switch accounts

setup-open-home.intent: The trader starts on the wallet home screen

ac2-navigate-market.intent: AC2: the trader is back on the ETH market page listing the new resting order
